label: gym_mizu_020_receptionist_01
text: I’m sure Kofu is real sad about forgetting his\nwallet here...

label: gym_mizu_020_receptionist_02
text: Please take it to him in [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Porto Marinada[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], on the\nother side of the desert! I’m counting on you!

label: gym_mizu_020_receptionist_03
text: [EMPTY 67]

label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_01a
text: What? YOU again?!

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_26
text: Vaultin’ Veluza! Where?! Where in the world...?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_27
text: Where in the world is my wallet?![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_28
text: Without my wallet, I won’t be able to get today’s\nhot item! It’ll get bought up by someone else![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_29
text: *sniffle*[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_01b
text: Don’t worry, ol’ man Kofu! I’ll run and look for it\nright now!

label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_02
text: Whaddya want? Ol’ man Kofu’s in the middle of\nsome superduper important ingredient buyin’!

label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_03
text: If yer thinkin’ about tryin’ to interrupt him, then\nI—his best apprentice—will have to stop you!

label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_04
text: So do ya have somethin’ super important to\nsay to us busy folks, or what?

label: gym_mizu_020_select_a
text: This is super important!

label: gym_mizu_020_select_b
text: Uh, I guess it’s not that important...

label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_05
text: Don’t bother us with somethin’ unimportant! Run\nback on home now, y’hear!

label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_06
text: Super important, eh? We’ll see about that!\nMaybe a battle will shut yer mouth!

label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_07
text: Dangit! That backfired... And now my wallet’s\nempty, too!

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_01
text: Heya, step right up...and tell me—what’s all the\nruckus about over here?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_08
text: O-ol’ man Kofu! Seems this kid’s got somethin’\nto say to ya.

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_02
text: What’s that, now? A customer here for little ol’\nwalletless, moneyless me? What kin I do for ya?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_select_01
text: I have your wallet!

label: gym_mizu_020_select_02
text: You forgot this!

label: gym_mizu_020_system_01
text: You returned Kofu’s wallet to him!

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_03
text: Vaultin’ Veluza! My wallet![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_04
text: Say what, now? My lobby staffer sent ya out here\nto bring it to me?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_05
text: Gahaha! That’s a huge help! Thanks for comin’\nall this way![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_06
text: I guess I should apologize for my li’l apprentice,\ntoo. Hope he didn’t bother ya too much![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_07
text: There’s somethin’ here at the Porto Marinada\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]auction[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] that we really wanna get our hands on.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_08
text: So, as you kin imagine, we were both a bit\nworked up to find I’d forgotten my wallet![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_shop_01
text: Ladies and gents! You won’t wanna miss this!\nHere comes today’s last item!

label: gym_mizu_020_shop_02
text: Feast yer eyes on the main event! I have ’ere the\nlegendary wakame seaweed of the Hoenn region!\r\nDo I have any takers?

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_10
text: Vaultin’ Veluza![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_11
text: I don’ even have to touch it—I can see it’s got the\nspringy texture of seaweed chock-full o’ nutrients![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_12
text: An’ just look at it! Look how it catches the light\nand shines so brilliantly![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_13
text: Ohhh, and that rich, fresh aroma of somethin’\nplucked straight outta the ocean![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_14
text: I need to get me some o’ that![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_15
text: Now listen, kid. If you wanna challenge me at the\nCascarrafa Gym, you’re gonna need some smarts.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_16
text: And this is the perfect place to test ya! Get the\nwinnin’ bid on that seaweed for this ol’ man![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_select_03
text: What’s a “winning bid”?

label: gym_mizu_020_select_04
text: OK! I’ll give it my best shot!

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_17
text:
Well, ya see...here at the auction, you gotta
compete with other customers for goods!\c
You gotta be aware of how much money ya have,
o’ course, but the person who bids the highest
price gets to buy whatever’s on sale![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_18
text: Gahaha! You already know the ins an’ outs of\nauctions at such a young age?\c\nYou’re somethin’ else, kid![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_19
text: Here ya are. Fightin’ funds for the auction! Be\nsmart with it, an’ win this ol’ man that seaweed![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_20
text: That was amazin’! You put those grown-up\nbidders to shame with yer biddin’ skills![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_21
text: Thank ya for winnin’ that seaweed for this ol’\nman. I’ll be takin’ it now, if ya don’t mind.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_system_02
text: You handed the legendary wakame seaweed\nto Kofu!

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_22
text: This seaweed’s a great catch! I’d be feelin’ low\nas the seabed if I’d failed to get my hands on it![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_23
text:
If there’s any o’ that money I gave ya left, feel
free to keep it as a tip!\c
You kin even use it to try yer hand at the auction
again if ya like![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_24
text: All righty. I’mma head on back to the Cascarrafa\nGym now.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
